get.description: Report whether the process has completed startup initialization.
Report whether the process is alive without testing downstream dependencies.
Report whether the process can serve requests, including the database when one is configured.

Browser navigation that starts an OIDC authorization-code login with PKCE at the identity provider and redirects there. returnTo is a same-origin relative path opened after login; anything else becomes /. assurance=strong requests two-step verification (teluni-aal2), enrolling an authenticator when needed; assurance=recent also forces a new authentication for operations that need it within five minutes. A lower achieved level redirects to /sign-in?error=assurance_not_met.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Provider redirect target. Validates the single-use login attempt, state, nonce and PKCE, provisions the application principal, sets the session cookie and redirects to the return path. Failures redirect to /sign-in?error= with login_failed, login_expired, email_unverified, account_unavailable, assurance_not_met or provider_unavailable.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Describe the current session and return its CSRF token for unsafe requests. A PENDING_LIMIT session must end another session before protected operations. Send x-teluni-activity: background from automatic polling so it does not extend the idle limit.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: End the current session here and at the identity provider and clear the cookie. Requires the session CSRF token in X-CSRF-Token and the panel Origin.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List the caller's unexpired sessions with minimal timing metadata, newest first.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

delete.description: End one of the caller's sessions, including the current one. Another person's session is reported as not found. Requires the CSRF token and the panel Origin.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: End every session of the caller, here and at the identity provider, and clear the cookie. Requires the CSRF token and the panel Origin.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: OpenID Connect back-channel logout endpoint for the identity provider. A valid, fresh, unreplayed logout token revokes the matching sessions; an invalid one is rejected with 400.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List this company's memberships, including suspended and removed records, by immutable ID. Requires company administration and two-step verification. Presentation names and emails come from the last verified sign-in and never authorize access. Cursors bind the caller, company and collection; access is checked on every page.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Suspend, reactivate or remove a membership with its observed version. Removal is terminal and affects only this company. Actor authority is rechecked under company-first transaction locks. The responsible administrator and last active administrator are protected. Reactivating an administrator requires the responsible administrator with strong authentication no older than five minutes. An unchanged status is a no-op; a lost response requires reloading the member list before another change.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Create a company whose creator becomes its responsible administrator. A repeated Idempotency-Key from the same person with the same content returns the same company; different content is rejected. Further administration requires two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List companies with a current active membership, newest first by immutable creation time and ID, with the caller's effective roles. Cursors are bound to the caller and collection; membership is checked again on every page. The default page has 50 entries, with a maximum of 100. Other members' companies are never visible.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Read a company and the caller's current access. A company the caller does not belong to is reported as not found.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Change company settings with the observed version. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List the branches the caller may see, active first and by name. Branch-scoped members see only their branches. Cursors are bound to the company and caller.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Create a branch; the time zone defaults to the company's. Active branch names are unique within the company regardless of case. A lost response can be reconciled by listing branches. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Read a branch the caller may see; any other branch is reported as not found.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Rename a branch or change its time zone with the observed version. Archived branches cannot change. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Archive a branch with the observed version, keeping it for references. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List the company's organization audit events, newest first. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-teluni_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque server-managed human session. Loopback development uses teluni_session. Unsafe methods also require the session CSRF token in X-CSRF-Token and a matching Origin.
